_meta.coverage: 101 verdicts for 101 netlist refs -- 100% of the FULL v11 variant reference set (plan Phase 3 exit criterion)
_meta.verdict_scale: KEEP = on the MINIMAL board as-is; OPTIONAL = site retained, population/DNP decided by qualification (supercaps, barometer, jumper, converter site); REMOVE = dropped from MINIMAL only (ADR-089 S1); REPLACE = superseded by a named new feature (J_PROG -> pogo pads)

C_BULK.reason: 100uF 10V bulk cap (DC-bias corrected part, order sheet)

C_CAP1.reason: 3.3F 2.7V supercap site 1: DNP on v10 (order sheet); burst storage RETAINED on MINIMAL as an optional site per ADR-089 S1 (ADR-006/036), population decision pending qualification

C_SOL1.reason: solar divider filter cap (as R_SOL1 chain)

D_BP1.reason: SS24 bypass-panel diode 1 (wing solar bypass; top-side per ADR-146)

D_BP2.reason: SS24 bypass-panel diode 2 (top-side per ADR-146; stage-1 board moved it)

D_HUB1.reason: SS24 hub-PV panel diode 1 (solar input protection)

J_PROG.reason: 2.54 mm 6-pin header removed on MINIMAL; replaced by functional pogo pads exposing the SAME six signals + EN RC (ADR-089 S1, ADR-121 amended in part; pogo header is the CANDIDATE implementation, its part selection pending gate G2 Phase 1.3).

J_VCC.reason: F33_VCC_SEL solder jumper (VSCAP/+3V3): leave open until supply selection verified (handfit list row 22); site retained, strap decision pending

J_W1.reason: wing socket 1 (board feature; support/wing interface -- its retention is tied to the support/wing interface decision, gate G5, and hardware must be weighed)

Q_CUT1.reason: cut FET AO3400A, channel 1 (release safety, V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md)

R_A0PD.reason: decoder address pulldown A0 (netlist: on /CUT_FIRE + GND; keeps decoder address defined at reset)

R_DIV1.reason: solar/SCAP divider 2.2M (netlist v11 values; v10 had 1M pair) -- SCAP monitoring chain

R_F1.reason: 100R F33 CE feed/filter (netlist: R_F1.1 on +3V3 with U2.5 CE)

R_FPD.reason: 100k pulldown holding all four cut-FET gates low via /CUT_FIRE (measured from netlist: R_FPD.1 on /CUT_FIRE with R_GPD1-4, .2 on GND) -- release-safety default-off

R_G1.reason: cut FET gate resistor, ch 1 (V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md gate chain)

R_GPD1.reason: gate pulldown, ch 1 (netlist: .2 on GND with R_FPD)

R_PROT1.reason: cut-loop protection resistor, ch 1 (netlist cut channel chain)

R_PU1.reason: 4k7 I2C SCL pullup (netlist: R_PU1.2 on /I2C_SCL with U1/U6/U_ADC1/2)

R_SH1.reason: 0.1 ohm 2512 Kelvin shunt, ch 1 (V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md; sense error budget)

R_SNS1.reason: shunt sense tap, ch 1 (V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md ADC chain)

R_SNSA1.reason: sense divider 300k, ch 1 (1/4 divider per V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md)

R_SOL1.reason: solar divider 220k (wing solar monitoring, netlist chain with R_SOL2)

U2.reason: F33 TX, the transmitter (ADR-089 S1). Part identity NOT settled: NiceRF page names LoRa2021F33-2G4; LCSC C53243927 reads LoRa1121F33-2G4-433MHz -- competing evidence recorded, pin verification pending (gate G2).

U3.reason: the ONE low-power LR2021 RX (ADR-089 S1). Footprint pin-verification pending (gate G2); shopping list records the operator's small module does NOT fit U3 or U_C as a drop-in (handfit shopping list row 14).

U5.reason: MAX-M10S GNSS retained on MINIMAL (ADR-089 S1); actual installed part on the operator's board is an unidentified 4-pin breakout -- needs identification (handfit list row 16; not established as the bare MAX-M10S footprint)

U6.reason: MS5611 barometer: DNP by decision on v10 (order sheet DNP table); retained on MINIMAL as an optional site pending cold-qualification evidence (ADR-089 retains GPS/tracking; NTC chain measures the cold today)

U7.reason: TPS7A02 3V3 LDO -- required power (ADR-089 S1 'ESP32 + required power')

U_ADC1.reason: ADS1115 #1: /SCAP_ADC + cut sense (plan Phase 0.2: both ADS1115 stay; ADR-148)

U_ADC2.reason: ADS1115 #2: solar dividers + cut sense (as U_ADC1)

U_C.reason: redundant second LR2021 RX removed on MINIMAL (ADR-089 S1; ADR-145 MOOT on MINIMAL). Its 4 control nets have no MCU endpoint (ADR-145). Site stays valid on non-MINIMAL variants.

U_CUT1.reason: cut-driver latch, channel 1 (release safety, ADR-129; netlist value SN74LVC1G373DBVR; stage-1 board carries a placeholder footprint part TODO(unverified))

U_DEC.reason: SN74LVC1G139 one-hot decoder serialising the four latch /OE lines -- hardware guarantee no two FETs conduct (V11-CUT-CHANNELS.md; release safety)

U_HUB_CVT.reason: hub PV converter site: part TODO(unverified), output net absent on v10 (order sheet DNP). Site kept as OPTIONAL pending a real converter part + netlist; NOT part of the MINIMAL radio set.

U_LORA1280.reason: ranging site D removed on MINIMAL (ADR-089 S1); ADR-138/139 gates bind only where site D exists. Netlist-vs-board divergence (U_LORA1280 vs U_E28) mooted by removal for THIS variant.
